title: Malaysia Cumulative Mean Revenue Loss
limitations: Historical input provenance is incomplete; the assessment is available for inspection only and is not recomputable.

The measure is a signed mean loss (neutral revenue minus event revenue), covering agriculture, forestry and fishing value added with conditional government revenue transmission; it is not a total-economy loss.
Causal identification is not claimed; estimates are conditional associations under the model's scenario assumptions.
Units are constant 2025 USD, GDP-deflated, with a fixed 2025 exchange rate; price and exchange-rate responses are not modeled.
